lead_raw_text:
The tetragonal crystal Sr8Mg4Mo4O24 (reduced formula Sr2MgMoO6) adopts space group F-43m (No. 216) with 40 atoms in the unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Mg and Mo each in octahedral coordination by six O neighbors, while Sr shows a 12-neighbor close-packed-like local arrangement. The Mg- and Mo-centered octahedra share corners with one another and faces with Sr-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, and corner-sharing also links Mo octahedra to each other, forming a three-dimensional periodic neighbor graph.
